title: Periplogenin suppresses the growth of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma in vitro and in vivo by targeting STAT3.
authors: Hu, Yamei; Liu, Fangfang; Jia, Xuechao; Wang, Penglei; Gu, Tingxuan; Liu, Hui; Liu, Tingting; Wei, Huifang; Chen, Hanyong; Zhao, Jiuzhou; Yang, Ran; Chen, Yingying; Dong, Zigang; Liu, Kangdong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子periplogenin靶向STAT3抑制食管鳞癌，虽涉及STAT3-DNA转录活性与分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合机制，方法以实验为主、对接为辅，与课题关联有限。
abstract: The mortality rate of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) is higher than that of other cancers worldwide owing to a lack of therapeutic targets and related drugs. This study aimed to find new drugs by targeting an efficacious therapeutic target in ESCC patients. Signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) is hyperactive in ESCC. Herein, we identified a novel STAT3 inhibitor, periplogenin, which strongly inhibited phosphorylation of STAT3 at Tyr705. Docking models and pull-down assays revealed that periplogenin bound directly and specifically to STAT3, leading to significant suppression of subsequent dimerization, nuclear import, and transcription activities. In addition, STAT3 knockdown cell lines were insensitive to periplogenin, whereas in contrast, STAT3-overexpressing cells were more sensitive to periplogenin, indicating that STAT3 was a target of periplogenin. Intraperitoneally administered periplogenin exhibited efficacious therapeutic effects in ESCC patient-derived xenograft models and dramatically impaired the phosphorylation of STAT3 and expression levels of STAT3-mediated downstream genes. Thus, our study demonstrated that periplogenin acted as a new STAT3 inhibitor, suppressing the growth of ESCC in vitro and in vivo, providing a basis for its potential application in ESCC treatment and prevention.
abstract_zh: 食管鳞状细胞癌（ESCC）的死亡率在全球范围内高于其他癌症，原因在于缺乏治疗靶点及相关药物。本研究旨在通过靶向ESCC患者中的有效治疗靶点来寻找新药。信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）在ESCC中过度活跃。在此，我们鉴定了一种新型STAT3抑制剂——periplogenin，它能强烈抑制STAT3在Tyr705位点的磷酸化。对接模型和pull-down实验表明，periplogenin直接且特异性地结合STAT3，导致后续二聚化、核转位及转录活性显著抑制。此外，STAT3敲低细胞系对periplogenin不敏感，而相反，STAT3过表达细胞对periplogenin更敏感，表明STAT3是periplogenin的靶点。腹腔注射periplogenin在ESCC患者来源的异种移植模型中展现出有效的治疗效果，并显著削弱STAT3的磷酸化及STAT3介导的下游基因表达水平。因此，我们的研究表明periplogenin作为一种新型STAT3抑制剂，在体外和体内抑制ESCC的生长，为其在ESCC治疗和预防中的潜在应用提供了基础。
